blurb: Celery City Craft offers a curated selection of over 50 craft beers, many brewed in Florida, along with crafted cocktails. The on-site kitchen serves creative sushi dishes and Korean-inspired street food. The venue features a spacious beer garden, live music, and a laid-back atmosphere honoring Sanford's history.
